s = Solver()
adj = [[Bool(f"e_{i}_{j}") for j in range(V)] for i in range(V)]

for i in range(V):
    s.add(Not(adj[i][i]))
    for j in range(i + 1, V):
        s.add(adj[i][j] == adj[j][i])

    return u * V + v + 1
